name: nested_vdi
description: Read a VirtualBox VDI that lies inside an E01 or raw image, in place: found by its NTFS data runs (a deleted one too) or at an offset, then through the VDI block map. info: header, block counts, guest partitions; ls: list a guest directory (paged); extract: one guest file to output; read: guest bytes. pyewf for E01, pytsk3 for ls/extract.

image.description: The outer image: an E01 (its other segments found beside it) or a raw image

offset.description: Where the outer volume starts, in 512-byte sectors (default 0)

runs.description: The VDI file's data runs in order, each [lcn, clusters] or {"lcn", "clusters"}, lcn null for a sparse run; omit when the VDI is contiguous

runs_file.description: The runs from a file: JSON (a list, or an object with runs) or one "lcn clusters" pair per line (lcn sparse for a sparse run)

cluster_size.description: The outer volume's cluster size in bytes, for the runs (default 4096)

vdi_offset.description: Where the VDI header starts, in bytes into the file the runs give, or into the volume when there are none (default 0)

partition.description: The guest partition's start sector, as info lists it (default: the only file system)

path.description: A path in the guest file system: the directory for ls (default /), the file for extract

inode.description: extract by inode (metadata address) instead of path

recursive.description: ls every directory below path too

output.description: Where extract (and read, over 4096 bytes) writes, under your work directory

limit.description: ls: entries in this page (default 500); every entry is kept in the file all_results names
